objects.name: ottoman
objects.caption: A round, upholstered ottoman in beige fabric with a slightly tufted top surface and four short, tapered dark wooden legs; it sits on a light-colored area rug in front of the sofa.

objects.name: coffee table
objects.caption: A rectangular two-tiered coffee table made of medium-toned wood with clean lines, featuring a top shelf holding books and a tablet, and a lower shelf with stacked books; it has straight, square legs and sits centered on the rug.

objects.name: sectional sofa
objects.caption: A three-seater sectional sofa in light beige fabric with rolled armrests, deep seat cushions, and multiple matching throw pillows; it has low, dark wooden block feet and is positioned against the wall unit.

objects.name: armchair
objects.caption: A compact armchair upholstered in rich rust-brown fabric with high back, rolled arms, and a single square beige pillow; it stands on four short, tapered dark wooden legs and is placed near the window.

objects.name: armchair
objects.caption: A larger armchair in tan or camel-colored fabric with a high back, wide rolled arms, and a plush beige pillow; it features slightly splayed dark wooden legs and is positioned to the right of the coffee table.

objects.name: potted plant
objects.caption: A large Ficus lyrata (fiddle-leaf fig) with broad, glossy green leaves arranged in a dense canopy, housed in a terracotta-colored ceramic pot with a smooth finish; the pot sits directly on the floor beside the coffee table.
